messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Can't Install RSTAN on Windows Server 2008 R2
parts:
Rtools provides a C++ compiler for Windows.

On the command line on the Windows 7 machine, can you verify that the g++ compiler can be found on the path? You can verify this with:
  g++ -v

This should tell you that g++ is at version 4.6.3 (some prerelease version that I don't remember off the top of my head). If you don't see that, then you'll need to add Rtools to the path first.


Daniel
